description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) for six different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at 10<sup>0</sup>, 10<sup>1</sup>, 10<sup>2</sup>, and 10<sup>3</sup>. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. The black line, representing “Base,” begins at approximately 60% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increases to approximately 67% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The brown line, representing "MEND," starts at about 65% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rises steadily to about 73% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The blue line, labeled "FT," commences at around 63% at a co-occurrence number of 1, and ascends to approximately 67% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The purple line, labeled "MEMIT," begins at approximately 68% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increases to roughly 73% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The red line, representing “IKE,” begins at around 64% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increases to approximately 68% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. Finally, the green line, labeled “ROME,” starts at about 72% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rises to approximately 76% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>.
